$comment_commands: install, build and start each run from the repository root, independently. If the app is in a subdirectory, cd into it in all three.
$comment: Pages the dashboard shows for this project. CI starts the app on every push to the default branch, captures these, and uploads them. Images are never committed — only this file is. Delete this file to turn screenshots off. See docs/screenshots/README.md.
$comment_auth: Optional. Only needed when the interesting pages are behind a login. Values are the NAMES of repo secrets, never the secrets themselves — this file is committed. Delete the whole auth block for a public site.
$comment_pages: Numbered so they sort into the order a person meets them. Up to 12. Optional per page: fullPage, waitFor (a selector), waitMs.
